def run(points,dt=.05,label='move',cams=['canvas_cam','practice_cam','scene_cam','side_cam']):
    points=np.asarray(points,float)
    if points.shape[1]==3: points=np.c_[points,np.tile(Q,(len(points),1))]

    print(label, 'tip',res.group('tcp_pose',now=True)[:3], 'plan',res.meta.get('plan'),'left',res.meta.get('time_left_s'),flush=True)
    return res

def move(p,speed=.06,hold=.3,label='move'):
    start=now()[:3]; p=np.array(p)

    a=np.linspace(start,p,n+1)[1:]
    a=np.r_[a,np.tile(p,(int(hold/.05),1))]
    out=None
    for i in range(0,len(a),180): out=run(a[i:i+180],label=label)
    return out

def polyline(points,speed=.015,label='stroke'):
    points=np.array(points,float); out=[]
    for a,b in zip(points[:-1],points[1:]):
